description: Fetch EIA monthly state/sector electricity or natural-gas averages, seasonal reported US residential/wholesale propane/heating-oil prices, weekly gasoline/diesel references, or ECB daily rates. Not real-time utility tariffs. Electricity converted from cents/kWh to USD/kWh; gas USD/Mcf; liquid fuels USD/US gallon. Returns observation date, retrieval time, source, units and cadence; fuel also includes publication time. Not tick prices, bank execution rates or local retail offers. Old/unavailable data fails explicitly. Reference lookups are counted separately from successful math. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.
name: buscalc_market_price_references
title: Dated fuel and currency references
